om: Hiding places in an ordinary British home and garden, written for rusj.no. gater: the clue that leads here, for ages 4–6, 7–9 and 10–12 (a missing age means the place does not suit it). No dangerous places: no oven, hob, washing machine, high shelves, roads or water.

steder.sted: In the fridge, next to the milk

gater.4: Look where we keep the cold milk!
gater.7: It's winter in here all year round, even in summer. Look by the milk!
gater.10: I'm cold inside, I light up when you open me, and I keep the food fresh. What am I?

steder.sted: In the freezer, by the ice cubes

gater.7: Brrr! The coldest place in the whole house. Look by the ice cubes!
gater.10: In here, water turns to stone and the ice lollies wait for summer.

gater.4: Look where we keep the bread!
gater.7: This is where the toast comes from. Have a look inside!
gater.10: I guard the slices and the crusts. My lid keeps in the smell of fresh baking.

gater.7: Round and full of treats to go with a cup of tea. Open the tin!
gater.10: I rattle with biscuits and crumbs, and everyone in the house knows where I'm kept.

gater.7: Forks, knives and spoons lie side by side in here. Open the drawer!
gater.10: We lie in a row like brothers and sisters: some poke, some cut and some scoop up porridge.

steder.sted: Under the kitchen table (tape it under the top)

gater.4: Crawl under the table where we have breakfast!
gater.7: We sit round me every day at mealtimes. Look underneath!
gater.10: I have four legs but cannot walk. Breakfast sits on my back. Look underneath.

steder.sted: In the fruit bowl, under a piece of fruit

gater.4: Look under the bananas and apples!
gater.7: Apples, bananas and oranges live here. Look under the fruit!
gater.10: A bowl full of vitamins. Lift the yellow, curved one and see what's underneath.

steder.sted: In the biggest saucepan in the cupboard

gater.7: We cook soup and spaghetti in it. Look in the biggest one!
gater.10: I have a lid and two ears, but I can't hear a thing. At teatime I get hot.

steder.sted: Under a magnet on the fridge door

gater.7: It holds drawings and notes on a cold door. Look underneath!
gater.10: I hold on without hands and without glue. You'll find me on the door of the cold cupboard.

gater.4: Look under a cushion on the sofa!
gater.7: We sit here to watch films. Lift up the cushions!
gater.10: Soft to sit on and lovely to nap on. Under one of my cushions, something is waiting.

gater.7: They hang in front of the window and keep the sun out. Peek behind!
gater.10: At night you draw me shut, in the morning you draw me open. What hides behind me?

steder.sted: On the bookshelf, between two books

gater.7: Fairy tales and stories stand here in a row. Look between the books!
gater.10: I'm full of stories, but I can't read. Look between my spines.

steder.sted: In the blanket on the sofa

gater.4: Look in the soft blanket on the sofa!
gater.7: It's warm and cosy and ready when we're cold. Look in the blanket!
gater.10: When the evening gets chilly, you snuggle under me. I'm not the duvet, but nearly.

gater.4: Look by the plant in the pot!
gater.7: It drinks water and grows towards the light. Look by the houseplant!
gater.10: I have roots but never go outside. I drink water and eat sunshine on the windowsill.

gater.4: Look where we turn on the telly!
gater.7: With it you can change channel without getting up. Look underneath!
gater.10: I have lots of buttons but no shirt. Without me, you'd have to get up to change channel.

gater.4: Look by the window where the sun comes in!
gater.7: From here you can see what the weather is doing. Look on the windowsill!
gater.10: I'm a narrow shelf under a glass you can see through. Flies like to rest on me.

steder.sted: Under a chair at the dining table

gater.7: You sit on me when you eat your dinner. Look under the seat!
gater.10: I have four legs and a back, but I always stand still by the table. Look under me.

steder.sted: In a board game or jigsaw box

gater.4: Look in a box with a game in it!
gater.7: The dice and the counters live here. Open a game box!
gater.10: Inside me are rules, pieces and maybe some dice. Games night begins with me.

steder.sted: In the cupboard under the stairs

gater.4: Look in the cupboard under the stairs!
gater.7: It's dark in here, with coats, shoes and the vacuum cleaner. Look under the stairs!
gater.10: I live beneath the steps, where the vacuum cleaner sleeps. Open my little door.

gater.4: Look under the mat by the door!
gater.7: We wipe our feet on it when we come in. Lift it up!
gater.10: Everyone walks all over me and I never complain. I lie where you come in.

steder.sted: In a welly by the door

gater.7: Perfect for rainy, muddy days. Look inside a welly!
gater.10: We always go out in pairs, never alone. In autumn we jump in puddles.

steder.sted: In the pocket of a coat on the hook

gater.7: It hangs by the door and keeps you warm outside. Check the pockets!
gater.10: I have arms but no hands, and pockets but no money. I hang by the door and wait.

steder.sted: In the basket of hats and gloves

gater.4: Look where the hats and gloves live!
gater.7: Here's everything that keeps your head and hands warm in winter.
gater.10: Your fingers and ears are glad of what lies here when it's frosty outside.

gater.4: Go where you can see yourself!
gater.7: When you look into me, you see yourself. Look by the mirror!
gater.10: I copy everything you do but never say a word. Smile at me and I'll smile back.

steder.sted: In the bath or shower (somewhere dry!)

gater.7: This is where you get clean from top to toe. Look in the bath!
gater.10: I fill up with water and bubbles, then I gurgle when you pull out my plug.

gater.7: Without them there'd be trouble in the loo. Look by the toilet rolls!
gater.10: I get shorter every day and I'm all white. You'll find me in the smallest room in the house.

gater.7: It scrubs your teeth clean morning and night. Look by the toothbrush!
gater.10: I have a hundred tiny hairs but never need a haircut. Morning and night I get toothpaste.

steder.sted: In a towel in the bathroom

gater.4: Look in the towel in the bathroom!
gater.7: The more you dry with it, the wetter it gets. Look in the towel!
gater.10: What gets wetter the more it dries? The answer hangs in the bathroom.

gater.4: Look by the soap where we wash our hands!
gater.7: It foams and smells nice. Wash your hands – and look by the soap!
gater.10: I get smaller every time you use me, and I make bubbles out of water.

steder.sted: Under the pillow on a bed

gater.4: Look under the pillow on the bed!
gater.7: You sleep here every night. Look under the pillow!
gater.10: At night your head rests on me and dreams. Lift me up!

gater.7: It's warm and snuggly and covers you at night. Look underneath!
gater.10: I'm full of feathers but I can't fly. At night I keep you warm.

steder.sted: With a teddy or soft toy

gater.4: Go to the teddy! It's looking after something.
gater.7: It's soft and cuddly and good to sleep with. See what teddy is hiding!
gater.10: I have button eyes and a heart made of fabric. At night I keep watch in bed.

gater.4: Look in the box of toys!
gater.7: The cars, dolls and bricks live here when nobody is playing with them.
gater.10: I'm full of fun but never join in. When you tidy up, I get everything back.

gater.7: Here's what keeps your toes warm. Look in the sock drawer!
gater.10: We come in pairs, but one of us always vanishes in the wash. Look in our drawer.

gater.7: Here you bounce higher than anyone. Look underneath!
gater.10: I throw you into the air and catch you again. Look under my mat.

steder.sted: In the sandpit (in a bag under the bucket)

gater.7: Here you bake cakes that nobody can eat. Look under the bucket!
gater.10: I'm a little beach without the sea. The castles built here can't stand the rain.

gater.7: Backwards and forwards, higher and higher! Look by the swing.
gater.10: I go back and forth all day without getting anywhere.

steder.sted: At the bottom of the slide

gater.4: Look at the bottom of the slide!
gater.7: Up the ladder and wheee down! Look at the bottom of the slide.
gater.10: You climb up me only to come down again fast. Look where the ride ends.

gater.7: Bikes, spades and the lawnmower live here. Look by the shed door!
gater.10: I'm a little house where nobody lives, but the rakes, spades and bikes sleep inside me.

gater.7: Wet clothes hang here to dry in the wind. Look by the pegs!
gater.10: I stretch across the garden, and on sunny days I wear everybody's socks.

steder.sted: Under the bird table or by the bird feeder

gater.4: Go where the birds have their dinner!
gater.7: Little birds come here for seeds in winter. Look under the bird table!
gater.10: I'm a restaurant where the guests have wings. In winter I'm always full.

gater.7: Flowers grow in it. Lift it up carefully!
gater.10: I'm a little home for roots. Lift me gently and see what's underneath.

gater.7: We use it to give the flowers a drink. Look by the watering can!
gater.10: I have a long nose full of holes, and the flowers are happy when I cry.

gater.7: It has one wheel and two handles and carries leaves and soil. Look inside!
gater.10: I have one wheel and two legs, and I carry heavy loads round the garden.

gater.4: Look under the bench in the garden!
gater.7: We sit here outside when the sun shines. Look under the bench!
gater.10: I have room for three in the sunshine, but I never get up. Look underneath me.

gater.4: Look under a chair in the garden!
gater.7: It waits outside for sunny days. Look under a garden chair!
gater.10: I stand outside in all weathers, waiting for someone to sit in the sun.

steder.sted: By a bike (in the basket or by a wheel)

gater.7: It has two wheels and a bell. Look by the bike!
gater.10: I have two wheels but no engine. The pedals make me roll.

gater.7: It's smaller than a tree but bigger than a flower. Look under a bush!
gater.10: I'm a tree that never grew up. Birds love to hide in me.

gater.7: Find the biggest tree you can see and look around the trunk!
gater.10: I have a trunk but I'm no elephant, and branches but no hands. Find the biggest of us.

gater.7: It's hard and grey and has been here for ages. Look under the stone!
gater.10: I'm older than the house and heavier than you. Turn me gently – a worm might live here.

gater.4: Go to the door where we come in!
gater.7: All the party guests come in this way. Look by the front door!
gater.10: I have a keyhole and a handle, and I say welcome without a word.

gater.7: We use it to sweep the path. Look by the broom!
gater.10: I have long hair on the wrong end, and I dance with dust and leaves.

gater.7: It goes round the garden and shows where it ends. Look on a post!
gater.10: We stand in a row round the garden, holding hands. The garden ends with us.

gater.7: A long row of bushes standing close together. Peek into the hedge!
gater.10: We stand so close that nobody can see through us. Every summer we get a trim.

gater.7: Flowers grow here in rows. Look in the bed – but don't tread on them!
gater.10: The bees love to visit me. Here the colours stand with their feet in the soil.

gater.7: It's long and green and squirts water. Look by the hosepipe!
gater.10: I'm as long as a snake but I don't bite. In summer I spray the flowers and the children.
